title: Ordinary tensor transport commutes with the signed total comparison
statement: Let f:X→Y, R,S and c:f⁻¹R≅S be the native pro-etale coefficient data [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write T_R,T_S for the ordinary tensor and Tot_R,Tot_S for their signed direct-sum totals. Let L:Mod(R)→Mod(S) be additive, e:L≅f* an ordinary pullback isomorphism, a,b normalized derived tensor models, d an ExactModel of L, and tc a TensorComparison with ordinary components μ(M,N):L(M⊗N)≅LM⊗LN [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction]. Suppose e(M⊗N);μ_native(M,N)=μ(M,N);(e(M)⊗e(N)) for every M,N. Write e_C for the termwise complex isomorphism. For every pair of unbounded complexes P,Q, the actual total comparisons satisfy Tot_S(e_C(P),e_C(Q));total_native(P,Q)=totalMap(a,b,L,μ,tc.comm,P,Q);e_C(Tot_R(P,Q)) [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback].

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product: ordinary tensor comparison, signed total complexes, and localization on flat K-flat representatives.

proof.text: Cancel the two ordinary isomorphisms in the compatibility hypothesis to obtain tensor(e(M),e(N));μ_native(M,N)⁻¹=μ(M,N)⁻¹;e(M⊗N).

Apply chain-map extensionality and the universal property of the total tensor direct sum in every degree. Expand each total comparison on a bidegree summand. Use the inverse ordinary square and naturality of e on that summand inclusion. This proves equality in every degree, including the case of no summands.

theorem proEtaleTensorTotalTransport
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (L : Mod R ⥤ Mod S) [L.Additive]
    (e : L ≅ proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c)
    (a : TensorModel R) (b : TensorModel S) (d : ExactModel L)
    (mu : ∀ M N : Mod R, L.obj (((tensor R).obj M).obj N) ≅
      ((tensor S).obj (L.obj M)).obj (L.obj N))
    (tc : TensorComparison L d a b mu)
    (he : ∀ M N : Mod R,
      e.hom.app (((tensor R).obj M).obj N) ≫
        (proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullback f R S c M N).hom =
      (mu M N).hom ≫ ((tensor S).map (e.hom.app M)).app (L.obj N) ≫
        ((tensor S).obj ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).obj M)).map (e.hom.app N))
    (P Q : CochainComplex (Mod R) ℤ) :
    let ec := (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex e (.up ℤ)).hom
    (total S).map (Prod.mkHom (ec.app P) (ec.app Q)) ≫
        proEtaleTensorPullbackTotal f R S c P Q =
      totalMap a b L mu tc.comm P Q ≫ ec.app ((total R).obj (P, Q))
